notes.title: 🎮 Update Alert! 🚀
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow gamers!

We're thrilled to announce the latest update to our beloved game. This time around, we've been hard at work refining your gaming experience to make it even more enjoyable.

Here's what's new:

🛠️ Revamped Training Mini-Game: We've given the implant installation training mini-game a makeover! Now, mastering this essential skill is smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

👀 HUD Text and Number Display Fixes: Say goodbye to those pesky text and number display issues in the HUD. We've squashed those bugs so you can focus on the game without any distractions.

📝 Typos, Begone!: We've combed through the game with a fine-tooth comb and eradicated those annoying typos. Your immersion in the game world is now seamless.

🐛 Gameplay Bug Fixes: We've tackled some pesky gameplay bugs that may have been bugging you. With these fixes, your gaming sessions will be smoother than ever.

Get ready to dive back into the action-packed world of our game, now with even more polish and refinement.

Happy gaming,
Octo Games

notes.title: We've released Cybersex: Lust Story - your own android adventure awaits!
notes.content:
We've immediately noticed that certain nuances were off - today we're also releasing an update containing translation fixes, fixed leaderboard, other minor improvements and bug fixes - feel free to share any issue you've stumbled upon, so we can make sure we've fixed every little thing and nothing is in your way to enjoy the game! 

It's time to explore the offbeat story full of fantasies, extraordinary interactions and mutual support, accompanied by profoundly detailed 18+ scenes that will tangle you in an unforgettable dance of love and technology, where the boundaries between android and human are blurred. Help her out when she needs it, be there for her, and you'll get a chance to teach her everything about our complicated human world and how we live and interact - both through real life situations and getting her implants that widen the range of perception. notes.title: Cybersex: Lust Story will be out really, really soon! 🤖
notes.content:
We'd like to invite you on a rather unique adventure - shift your own fate while interacting with an enigmatic and unusual android creature - help her navigate through the nuanced world of human interaction by talking, helping, spending time together and deepening her everyday life and perception of reality. While going through that, you'll be able to get her implants, which will absolutely shift her senses and thoughts - starting with basic things like taste or tangible sensations and leading to further deeper understanding of what real human interaction and emotions might be. 

Get on the release on time, so you won't miss out anything special we could prepare 🧐
